description: Correct action-economy preparation so executing an already committed Turn action does not spend its action cost a second time.
planning_goal: Within the action-economy preparation owned by system_bridge/action_economy/action-economy-transaction.js, preserve Frame Conn Turn state as the authority for planning-time action expenditure. After prepareActionEconomyTransaction reads the authoritative action-economy snapshot, detect whether snapshot.metadata.rawState.usedActions contains an unexecuted committed entry whose actionId matches context.semanticAction.id. When that exact committed entry exists, rebuild the existing ActionEconomyRequest with ignoreActionCost true before validation so the already-spent action cost is not validated or committed again. When no matching unexecuted committed entry exists, preserve the request unchanged and keep ordinary action-economy behavior. This must allow committed full.disengage effect execution to complete successfully without changing Disengage status/suppression behavior.
acceptance_criteria: prepareActionEconomyTransaction recognizes a matching unexecuted committed Turn entry from the authoritative snapshot.
For that entry only, the existing ActionEconomyRequest is rebuilt with ignoreActionCost true before action-economy validation.
The same ignoreActionCost request is retained for the later action-economy commit hook, so no duplicate action cost mutation occurs.
Requests without a matching unexecuted committed Turn entry remain unchanged and retain normal action-economy validation and commit behavior.
Committed full.disengage can execute its existing status-orchestration effect without becoming partial/failed because its Full Action was already spent during planning.
No Disengage duration, status, suppression, targeting, native Lancer behavior, or unrelated action effect is changed.
non_goals: Change action costs or turn limits.
Bypass execution transactions or action-economy hooks.
